reasoning: The requirements state that the graph must consist of exactly two vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 4 and that every vertex belongs to one of these cliques. Two cliques of size 4 cover only 8 vertices, but the graph must have 13 vertices, leaving 5 vertices with no clique to belong to, which contradicts the “every vertex belongs to one of these cliques” condition. Hence no such graph can exist.
cot_trace: We need graph with 13 vertices, but says consists of exactly 2 vertex-disjoint cliques of size 4, every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and only edges are within these cliques. That accounts for 8 vertices. But we have 13 vertices total, contradiction: every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, but only two cliques of size 4 cover 8 vertices, leaving 5 vertices not in any clique. So impossible. Thus UNSAT.
